description.value:
奇物，传说

这太巨大无比的望远镜可以被用来观察各种星体事物，包括各种 恒星（星星）Star 、各个 荒宇系统Wildspace Systems、以及 星界海Astral Sea 中的景象（像是神灵的城市或者死去神祇的遗骸）。

在花费1小时校准望远镜后，你可以尝试旅行至望远镜正指向的 行星Planet 或天体上。在这一小时的结束时，你需要进行一次[[/save ability=int dc=17]]（奥秘&Reference[skill=Arcana]）检定。若检定成功，你和8个其他的自愿生物可以触碰望远镜，你们（与你们所携带与穿着的一切物品）都将被安全的传送至你想到达的那处目的地，其最近的数处未被占据空间内。若检定失败，这样的传送会出现一些事故，而非完全安全。

DM投掷望远镜之旅事故表，或者选择表上最符合战役的一项事故，来决定事故具体发生了什么。

望远镜之旅事故
[[/r d6]]事故
1传送后，旅行者们出现并漂浮在星界海之中。
2传送后，旅行者们出现在了一个不同的存在位面，具体位面由DM决定或随机选择。
3过量的宇宙能量令望远镜过载，导致它爆炸、任何身处望远镜周围60尺范围内的生物都将受到[[/damage 8d6 type=necrotic]]伤害。任何受到此伤害但存活的生物都将被转化为另一种类的生物，就如同被施加了法术@UUID[Compendium.dnd5e_classpack.spell.Item.8Q1GXPGBXIdBOoqY]{转生术 Reincarnate} 的效应一般。
4一个自星界海而来的生物（例如 @UUID[Actor.Gkfx5e3lPDzinsyI]{吉斯洋基骑士Githyanki Knight (MM'14)}）出现在望远镜周围60尺范围内。由DM决定它的态度如何。
5传送后，旅行者们出现在了不同的星球或天体上，不过新的地点与原定目的地同处一个荒宇系统，且十分靠近目的地。
6传送后，旅行者们抵达了他们的目的地，但出现时，所有人都被包裹在一团无害的粘液之中。

This enormous telescope allows you to view distant celestial objects, including stars, Wildspace systems, and Astral Sea phenomena like the cities of deities or the petrified husks of dead gods.

After spending 1 hour calibrating the telescope, you can attempt to travel to the planet or celestial body at which the telescope is currently pointed. At the end of the hour, make a [[/save ability=int dc=17]] (&Reference[skill=Arcana]) check. On a successful check, you and eight other willing creatures touching the telescope, along with everything all travelers are wearing and carrying, safely teleport to unoccupied spaces at the intended destination. On a failed check, a mishap occurs instead. The DM rolls on the Telescope Travel Mishaps table to determine the mishap or chooses a mishap that's good for the campaign.

Telescope Travel Mishaps
[[/r d6]]Mishap
1The travelers appear adrift in the Astral Sea.
2The travelers appear on a different plane of existence, determined randomly or chosen by the DM.
3Excess cosmic energy overloads the telescope, causing it to explode. Each creature within 60 feet of the telescope takes [[/damage 8d6 type=necrotic]] damage. Any Humanoid who survives this damage is transformed into a different kind of creature, as if it had been subject to the @spell[Reincarnate] spell.
4A creature from the Astral Sea (such as a @creature[githyanki knight]) appears within 60 feet of the telescope. The DM decides its attitude.
5The travelers appear on a different planet or celestial body in the Wildspace system nearest to their target destination.
6The travelers arrive at their intended destination, but they each appear coated in harmless slime.
